What to look for: in the DXC pane(s), find the payload struct's bool-matrix field access.
The compiler emits a pointer bitcast from the bool-matrix-backed field to a pointer of a
32-bit-per-lane integer vector of the same lane count, then loads through that wider-vector
pointer and compares each extracted lane against zero. Compare this to what you'd expect if
the same field held individual scalar bools packed one bit apart (as the LLVM vector data
layout used here specifies): the load reads lanes 32 bits apart, not 1 bit apart. This shape
is unchanged between DXC's oldest lib_6_6-capable release and current trunk.
